title: SRA commutative encryption primitives
description: Implement SRA commutative encryption using num-bigint + num-integer crates for modular exponentiation. Use a well-known RFC 3526 2048-bit MODP group (no safe prime generation needed). Keypair: random e coprime to p-1, d = modular inverse of e mod (p-1). Encrypt: c = m^e mod p. Decrypt: m = c^d mod p. NOT constant-time (acceptable for game context — not protecting state secrets). When WASI-Crypto stabilizes (baize-jspg), swap num-bigint backend for WASI-Crypto host calls. Protocol layer unchanged.
close_reason: SRA commutative encryption with num-bigint, RFC 3526 2048-bit MODP group. generate_keypair, sra_encrypt, sra_decrypt, mod_inverse. 12 tests pass including commutativity proofs.
